Subject: Payment routing and vendor onboarding for Arcadia pilot

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on the procurement path for the Arcadia pilot: 

Recap (from today’s discovery)
- Arcadia is interested in a 6-week pilot for 3 inference endpoints (clinical triage & summarization).
- Primary constraint: AP prefers PO-based vendors with vendor onboarding and NET 45 terms.
- Short-term need: get pilot running this month; procurement team is open to one-off exceptions if SR is small and card payment is possible.
- Marketplace interest: Arcadia asked whether billing via AWS Marketplace is an option (they prefer centralized cloud billing).

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll attach our vendor onboarding checklist and a SOW stub for the pilot (see attachments).
2) Can you confirm whether Arcadia’s procurement would accept a PO for a pilot with NET 30 or NET 45? If they need NET 45 we’ll note that for commercial.
3) If procurement needs a vendor packet (W9, insurance cert, SOC2 snapshot), Marissa will share the packet and start vendor onboarding in parallel.
4) If card payment is acceptable for the pilot, please confirm the monthly card limit and whether a single charge is preferred.
5) On marketplace: Ben will check whether we can provision the pilot under AWS Marketplace billing or whether direct billing is required.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, redwood-sow-pilot-stub.docx

Suggested owners: Aditya (technical + timeline), Marissa (vendor docs & onboarding), Ben (marketplace / billing options).

Available for a 15-min follow-up tomorrow morning if that helps to accelerate onboarding.

—
Aditya Rao

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@arcadiahealth.com>

Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment routing and vendor onboarding for Arcadia pilot

Thanks Aditya — good summary. A few clarifications from procurement and legal: 

- Vendor packet: procurement requires a completed vendor onboarding form, W9, and proof of insurance. We can accept the vendor packet electronically.
- Payment terms: Arcadia’s standard is NET 45 on PO for new vendors. For small pilots we sometimes make an exception to allow corporate card (corp P-card) up to $20,000/month, but that needs approvals from Finance.
- Marketplace: We prefer AWS Marketplace for hosted SaaS where possible because it simplifies internal chargebacks. However, Marketplace purchases need the vendor to be listed and invoicing to be through AWS — that often adds a 30–45 day lead time to set up.

Questions: 
1) Can Redwood provide a W9 and COI (certificate of insurance) now?
2) If we go card route for the pilot, can Redwood issue a single invoice/receipt and accept card payment rather than PO?
3) If PO is required, are you able to accept NET 45? If not, what alternate term do you need for the pilot?

If you can send the vendor packet we’ll start internal review and let you know the expected onboarding lead time.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Director, Clinical Operations
Arcadia Health
samantha.liu@arcadiahealth.com

Looping in a couple of quick clarifications from finance and marketplace: 

- W9 & COI: attached vendor packet includes both items (redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf). We also have a current SOC 2 Type II snapshot that we can provide under NDA.
- Card vs PO: for pilots under $20k we typically accept corporate card. If Arcadia wants to use a PO with NET 45, we can accept it but will flag the deal for finance review (makes billing margin slightly higher for us). For speed to pilot, card is the quickest path.
- Marketplace: Ben — can you confirm whether we can list a small pilot charge through AWS Marketplace as a chargeable item (one-off or recurring)? If that’s not possible quickly, we should do direct billing.

Suggested immediate plan:
1) Aditya to ask procurement whether they can do card for the pilot (confirm monthly limit and preferred card holder).
2) If card OK: procurement sends card details via our secure payment token link; Marissa provisions onboarding concurrently.
3) If PO required: procurement sends PO to invoices@redwood.ai; we accept NET 45 but need PO scanned into HubSpot and a signed SOW.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (W9, COI, vendor form)
